# LLM / VLM models

A generative language or vision-language foundation model participates in inference, including small foundation models and tool pipelines.

These are the best values among the cited, protocol-matched results in each recorded snapshot and model category. They are not claims about current field-wide SOTA. Different targets, splits, inputs, time windows, and training regimes are not comparable.
